features.name: Bulk Office conversion
features.description: Turn whole folders of Word, Excel, and PowerPoint files into clean PDFs in one run.
features.notes: Uses installed Microsoft Office (COM) when present.

features.name: Images and text to PDF
features.description: Convert JPG/PNG/TIFF images and plain text files into PDF.

features.name: Markdown to PDF
features.description: Render Markdown into a styled PDF (plain-text fallback if Word is not installed).
features.notes: Styled rendering uses Word; without Word, Markdown converts as plain text.

features.name: Drop-folder workflow
features.description: Drop files into the input folder, click Run, collect results from the output folder.

features.name: Scan paper to PDF
features.description: Capture from a flatbed or document-feed scanner directly into AutoPDF.
features.notes: TWAIN and network (ESCL) scanners via NAPS2; native Windows (WIA) devices supported too.

features.name: Rule-based splitting
features.description: Cut one big PDF into per-document files using zones, text patterns, bookmarks, or page ranges.

features.name: Visual Zone Mapper
features.description: Draw boxes on the page to mark where the cut points and capture areas are; preview live.
features.notes: Four view modes: modal overlay, new tab, popup window, and split view.

features.name: AI-suggested boundaries
features.description: Ask the local AI to propose where one document ends and the next begins.
features.notes: Optional; requires a local Ollama model.

features.name: Index built during the split
features.description: While splitting, capture fields from each section straight into a CSV/XLSX index.

features.name: Design once, apply to a folder
features.description: Build an extraction template on a sample document, then run it across an entire folder.

features.name: Three ways to capture a field
features.description: Fixed zone, find-by-pattern (regex), or let the local AI find the value.

features.name: Tagged (label-following) fields
features.description: Mark a label such as 'Invoice No.' and the value is pulled from beside it on every document, even when its position shifts.

features.name: AI field proposal
features.description: The local AI suggests a complete set of fields, patterns, and a filename rule from a sample.
features.notes: Optional; Ollama-backed. Also proposes reusable patterns for the library.

features.name: Auto-rename on extract
features.description: Rename each output file from the values it extracted using a {field} pattern.

features.name: Value formatting
features.description: Normalize captured values: currency, dates, numbers, phone, upper/lower/trim.

features.name: Index Creator
features.description: Build a CSV/XLSX catalog of every file in a folder tree, with columns from folders, filename parts, and in-PDF content.

features.name: Saved recipes
features.description: Reusable Basic / Mid / Complex index recipes so a run is one click.
features.notes: Ships with the BU demo Basic/Mid/Complex recipes.

features.name: Config-driven date formatting
features.description: Normalize raw dates to a chosen format (demo presets output MM/DD/YYYY).
features.notes: Works via the recipe; an in-UI date-format picker is still to come.

features.name: OnBase XML Index export
features.description: Emit a Hyland OnBase XML Index DIP file alongside CSV/XLSX for direct ingestion.
features.notes: Schema-accurate to OnBase Foundation 24.1; verified on the 30-file demo set.

features.name: Workflow chaining
features.description: Chain steps: Split, Convert, AI re-group, Filter, Rename, Remove blanks, JS script.
features.notes: Functional; the single-threaded engine can stall if a Preview and Run overlap.

features.name: Scheduler
features.description: Run a saved Workflow on a watch folder on a cron-style schedule.
features.notes: Built; hardening and run-isolation are ongoing.

features.name: Local-only, no cloud
features.description: All conversion, OCR, splitting, and extraction run on your machine. No telemetry.

features.name: One-click portable launcher
features.description: AutoPDF.exe starts the server and opens the browser; nothing is installed or registered.

features.name: Opt-in update checks
features.description: Optionally check GitHub/GitLab/Bell-SW for engine version strings only — never document content.

features.name: PIN-gated public sharing
features.description: Optionally reach AutoPDF over a Cloudflare tunnel, protected by an access PIN.
features.notes: Public at autopdf.quiddityinnovations.com; health probes stay open.

features.name: Turn AI off entirely
features.description: A Settings toggle greys out all AI surfaces for a cleaner UI when Ollama is not used.
